dhp212:4:
bhayaṁ → priyebhyo jāyate śokaඃ priyebhyo jāyate bhayam 
priyebhyo vipramuktānaṁ nāsti śokaඃ kuto bhayam (bj: avadānaśataka. 8)
dhp217:4:
piyaṁ → śīlamatu suyi sajo dhamaṭho sadhujīvano 
atmano karako sadhu ta jano kurati priu (bj: prā. dha. C. 24); dharmasthaṁ śīlasampannaṁ 
hīmantaṁ satyavādinam 
ātamanaඃ kārakaṁ śāntaṁ 
taṁ janaඃ kurute priyam (bj: saṁskṛtadharmapada 5.24)
